item.title: Sanford Health, North Memorial Health enter into 10-year oversight agreement with Attorney General’s Office
item.description:
Publication Date: August 28, 2026

Merger between health systems to proceed with commitments to make $600M in investments in North Memorial Health system, including Robbinsdale Hospital, and to maintain the Level 1 trauma center and extensive core services at Robbinsdale for 10 years

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/28_Sanford-NorthMemorial.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison secures temporary block on USPS unlawful rule about mail voting
item.description:
Publication Date: August 28, 2026

Federal court issues temporary restraining order to block rule from taking effect, calls compliance with it ‘practically impossible’ before November election

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/28_USPS.asp
